fact.claim: With DNS validation, ACM can renew a certificate indefinitely without further action from you, as long as the certificate is in use (associated with other AWS resources) and the CNAME record stays in place.
fact.question: How long can ACM keep renewing a DNS-validated certificate without action from you?

values.display: your CNAME record remains in place

qualifiers.condition: the certificate is in use and the CNAME record remains in place

evidence.quote: If you chose DNS validation in your certificate request, ACM can renew your certificate indefinitely without any further action from you, as long as the certificate is in use (associated with other AWS resources) and your CNAME record remains in place.
evidence.title: AWS Certificate Manager FAQs | Certificate Management | Amazon Web Services

fact.note: FAQ Managed Renewal. The same sentence without 'indefinitely' answers the bare-domain question; this quote is the first occurrence.
fact.author: mine-07-faq

votes.reason: Quote states indefinite renewal without action and both conditions.
